newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Advantage sees H2 depressed by NZ economy.
newsitem.headline: Advantage sees H2 depressed by NZ economy.

text.p: Advantage Group Ltd, a supplier of electronic scanning equipment, cash registers and terminals, said on Friday it expected its second half result to be adversely affected by the depressed New Zealand retail economy.

"Whilst sales in Australia are increasing and there are continuing signs of future growth there, the New Zealand market has suffered both from a drop in retail demand and a reduction in margin suffered in defending market share against increased competition," Advantage said in a statement.
"In addition, Advantage is affected by an inability to achieve schedule deliveries of a number of new technologies due to late delivery of product from several manufacturers.
"This involves only a delay in sales but that delay will affect the end of year result."

While the second half of the current year would not achieve the company's expectations, it said it was confident the restructuring steps taken and the other strategies planned and implemented over the past two years were going to produce the desired results.
Advantage did not specify what its profit expectations were and a company spokesperson was not immediately available for comment.
